title: Return Merchandise Tracking Log
subtitle: Return Merchandise Movement: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Return Merchandise Tracking Log covers return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody. The returns coordinator records Return Merchandise Movement events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Return Merchandise Tracking Log keeps Return Merchandise Movement exceptions visible until the returns coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Return Merchandise Tracking Log at customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point. Document return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody identity before Return Merchandise Movement begins. Compare return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody findings with stated Return Merchandise Movement criteria; route unresolved Return Merchandise Movement issues to returns disposition reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Return Merchandise Movement, identify responsible parties, customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point, and the linked return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody source.

fields.label: Item, serial, lot, quantity, and package

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Return Merchandise Movement facts for return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Return Merchandise Movement tracked controls
items: Refund, replacement, repair, restock, or rejection routing

sections.title: Status decision and next trigger
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Return Merchandise Movement event before closeout. Returns Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Financial outcome requested before condition review
blocks.guidance: Pause Return Merchandise Movement when authorization, identity, safe handling, custody, or disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Return Merchandise Movement proof and route unresolved return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody scope to returns coordinator.
